title.zh: 大吞噬理论

summary.zh: 基模的扩张正在重新划定研究与工作的边界，这篇讨论把它放到更广泛的社会变化中。
summary.en: A discussion of how expanding foundation-model capabilities reshape research, work, and society.

title.zh: 大合作理论

summary.zh: 从转向大模型研究的经历出发，强调选择合作者、及时公开工作，以及进入活跃研究网络。
summary.en: Lessons from moving into LLM research: find collaborators, release work promptly, and participate in productive research networks.

title.zh: 大耍起理论

summary.zh: 把身心状态放在首位，在不承担债务的前提下尝试看似难以完成的事。
summary.en: Prioritize well-being and explore ambitious possibilities without taking on debt.

title.zh: 大理论理论

summary.zh: 鼓励博士生把自己的认识整理成可讨论的框架，以澄清研究方向并让潜在合作者理解自己。
summary.en: Encourages doctoral researchers to articulate frameworks that clarify their thinking and make their interests legible to collaborators.

title.zh: 大密度理论

summary.zh: 用单位时间内活动的价值解释成长差异，关注能够改善后续判断与行动的投入。
summary.en: Explores differences in growth through the value of activities per unit of time, especially investments that improve later decisions.

title.zh: 大审美理论

summary.zh: 讨论研究选题、论文呈现、报告、简历与个人主页中的审美判断，以及清晰表达的价值。
summary.en: Examines judgment and presentation in research questions, papers, talks, résumés, and personal websites.

submitted_observation.verification_note: 关键词检索直接观察。不确定性低。

title.zh: 关于科研展示与设计的讨论

summary.zh: 这篇前导讨论把设计视为科研交流的一部分，主张降低理解成果的成本；原帖同时介绍作者自己的设计产品。
summary.en: A precursor discussion arguing that design can make research easier to understand; the original also promotes the author’s design product.

title.zh: 对大斜率理论的反思

summary.zh: 质疑把短期可验证的高回报当作唯一准则，提醒读者考虑需要长期探索的研究。
summary.en: Challenges an exclusive focus on quickly measurable returns and draws attention to research that requires prolonged exploration.

submitted_observation.verification_note: 多次检索与thread核验。不确定性低。

title.zh: 大开放理论

summary.zh: 主张在学科、与人交往、前沿技术和科研失败面前保持学习意愿，避免先入为主的评价妨碍交流。
summary.en: Encourages openness to disciplines, people, new technology, and research setbacks, rather than letting preconceptions prevent learning.

title.zh: 大水群理论

summary.zh: 把持续参与小型技术与科研社群视为建立关系的方法，强调反复交流带来的熟悉感与合作机会。
summary.en: Treats sustained participation in small technical and research communities as a way to build familiarity, relationships, and collaboration opportunities.

title.zh: 关于研究生阶段杠杆与选择的讨论
title.en: Leverage and Choices in Graduate Research

summary.zh: 区分投入努力与选择值得投入的事情，讨论研究生如何重新审视评价体系，并对可能改变人生方向的决定负责。
summary.en: Distinguishes working hard from choosing worthwhile work, asking graduate researchers to reassess inherited measures of success and take responsibility for major decisions.

title.zh: 大Bench理论：基模吞噬下PhD只能造bench

summary.zh: 讨论将研究方向转化为基模友好的问题、数据与评测任务。
summary.en: Discusses framing research as foundation-model-friendly problems, datasets, and benchmarks.

title.zh: 大实习理论：真实反馈才是杠杆

summary.zh: 强调实习中获得的真实问题反馈，而非学校与头衔。
summary.en: Emphasizes real-world feedback from internships over institutional titles.

title.zh: 大粉理论：推特/小红书粉丝 > Google Scholar引用

summary.zh: 以粉丝数量与学术引用的对比，讨论博士生的注意力资源。
summary.en: Compares social-media followers with citations as resources for doctoral researchers.

title.zh: 大日结理论

summary.zh: 从互信下降与技能变化讨论工作结算周期的缩短。

title.zh: 大斜率理论：做斜率最高的事

summary.zh: 主张优先投入进展斜率较高的事情。
summary.en: Argues for prioritizing activities with a higher rate of progress.

title.zh: HR理论：AI PhD更适合转行做HR

summary.zh: 将博士生的传播、技术判断、人脉和工具能力与招聘工作类比。
summary.en: Compares PhD communication, technical judgment, networks, and tool skills with recruiting work.

summary.en: Questions heavy investment in skills LLMs may soon automate and argues for more discerning effort, rather than doing nothing.
